NO, WE WON'T SHUT UP.

Your Report Is Protected

Military security: same as the International Criminal Court, under the US First Amendment.

Encrypted instantly: report is protected before it leaves your phone, and protected by senior engineers.

Your choice: You can stay anonymous or let us give your name to trusted people who can help.

Legal oversight: Only qualified people like lawyers and case workers are allowed to see it.

SOMEONE'S HURTING ME RECORD MY STORY

You're Not Alone

Thousands of survivors have already come forward. Your voice matters, and your story deserves to be heard. This isn't just about you—it's about all of us, standing together, refusing to be silenced any longer.

Every report helps build the truth. Every voice adds strength to our collective call for justice. You don't have to carry this alone anymore.

What Happens After You Tell Us

1. You Send

Your report is encrypted and stored on our secure servers

2. Emergency Triage

Urgent cases immediately referred to trusted charities

3. Computer Review

Private AI scans to protect reviewers and flag priorities

4. Legal Review

Barristers check for serious crimes and safeguarding

5. Inquiry Access

Case officers review reports for the inquiry

6. Redacted Sharing

With your permission, redacted testimony shared with partners

7. Protected Always

Never shared without consent unless you're in danger

How This Works

Your Safety First

Everything you share is encrypted from the moment you type it. Your report is protected by the same technology used by international courts and human rights organisations worldwide.

Legal Protection

Overseen by barristers and protected under whistleblowing laws. Your identity is kept confidential unless you choose otherwise. We handle your information with the highest legal standards.

Get Support

If you need immediate help or someone to talk to, these organisations are here for you:

Emergency Help

If you're in immediate danger, call 999

Talk to Someone

Confidential support available 24/7

Counselling

Professional trauma-informed care
